question: What powers arise in this stage alongside the knowledge of distant hearing?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is attained.
The paralysis of bonds is also attained.
These powers are presented together in the same context.
inference: This stage yields knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
uncertainties: stobha can imply arrest, suppression, or immobilization depending on context.
